---
title: "Feature Roadmap"
---

The following lightweight improvements could greatly enhance the system.

## Prompt optimisation

* Consolidate `DirectionalStyle` and `DistanceStyle` into a single style
  object so Gemini receives fewer instructions.
* Provide sample question&answer pairs in the system prompt to guide the
  model toward concise replies.
* Encourage tool usage over code execution for simple queries and reuse
  past detection results when possible.

## Pipeline enhancements

* Add a unified configuration file for dataset paths and API keys.
* Implement caching for expensive API calls in `scene_understanding`.
* Introduce automated evaluation scripts for detection accuracy.

## UI and user experience

* Expose response style switches in the Streamlit app.
* Add keyboard shortcuts for starting/stopping the live agent.

## Data handling

* Improve depth/pose scaling heuristics in `StrayDataset`.
* Support additional dataset formats beyond StrayScanner.

## Testing

* Migrate essential tests from `.deprecated` to the current package
  structure.
